meta.name: Shiro Daika

waivers.population_consistent_with_housing: First-pass fabric at the settled wall: every band drew, but realized machi density leaves the census ~130 households short of 12,360/5; the GM (2026-08-10) deferred interior fullness to the fabric-first regeneration (future-work.md #2/#5) rather than grind the packs further this pass.
waivers.city_no_large_empty_space: The ~1.5-acre pockets that remain rotate to a new spot on every reflow because the first-pass packs under-fill the settled wall by ~8%; the stable cores are all claimed (the drill grounds, the moat firebreak, the rampart approach, the S-gate column ground) and the rotating residue is the same deferred-fullness gap (GM 2026-08-10, future-work.md #5).

meta.crop_outlier_ok: Outside the rampart the map carries only the gate furniture, the wharf works, the towpath and the aqueduct until feature 021 fills the interior; sparse outliers at this stage are the build order showing through, not a siting error.

_regression.source: Shiro Daika as the GM caught it (2026-08-10): the north sluice gate sits 15.8px from the feeder's centerline on a 22px channel - the gate's frame spans bank to bank, so a gate offset by two-thirds of the half-width reads as unattached to the water it gates. It passed sluice_gates_on_water because that rule measured to the BANK (15.8 - 11 = 4.8px past it, inside the 6px tolerance) rather than to the CENTERLINE a spanning frame must sit on. The GM's note: 'I know we have automated checks for this, so I'm not sure how this keeps happening over and over again.' This fixture is the map itself, per the standing procedure of feeding the offending map back in as the test input.
